findings.fact: $100 minimum net payout after split; withdrawals eligible every 7 days, automatic closure of open trades and read-only account while processing; monthly withdrawal cap $10,000 per client; excess may be deferred at provider discretion.
findings.impact: Withdrawal ceilings and operational processing affect realizable cashflow.

findings.program: Giveaway, free, competition and promotional accounts
findings.fact: 50/50 profit split; payout amount computed on at most 2% of initial account size, then split; 30-day payout frequency. On $15k, $300 capped profit basis means $150 trader payout.
findings.impact: Materially different economics from purchased accounts.

findings.fact: Provider reserves right to suspend or terminate service with or without prior notice; right to deny service at sole discretion at any time; contract also permits unilateral terms changes without advance notice.
findings.impact: Broad contractual discretion; examine payout protection, notice and dispute remedy before assigning B1.

findings.fact: Provisions on evaluation and allocation limits repeat with different rules: first says only one evaluation per size/plan at a time; later says identical accounts may be held with total allocation cap $400k, versus $1m otherwise.
findings.impact: Potential material inconsistency in permissible simultaneous accounts.
findings.verification: Check whether updated second clause supersedes first before applying B2.

findings.fact: Qualitative restrictions include 'usual trade sizes', 'excessive margin', 'gambling', and trading 'consistent with standard forex and financial market operations'; violations may result in transaction removal and account termination.
findings.impact: Potentially discretionary classification of trades and profits.
findings.verification: Confirm absence of numeric thresholds in applicable FAQ and no B1 double-count.

findings.fact: Terms name ICHIBAN TECH LTD (Cyprus HE470329) and SUCCESSIO LTD (Seychelles 245758) as representing Funded7 without clearly identifying which is counterparty for each service.
findings.impact: Identified entities, but specific contracting entity and registry status require independent verification.

findings.fact: Terms reserve ability to modify or replace conditions at any time without prior notice; continuing use treated as acceptance.
findings.impact: Version control and retroactive impact require investigation.

reasonNoScore: Independent payout proof, registry checks and other criteria missing. No score invented.
